name: DOCX explicit list marker extraction
finding: OfficeText.docx preserved DOCX text but discarded explicit paragraph numPr and word/numbering.xml semantics, so list item text was returned as ordinary paragraphs.

implementation.format: Resolves explicit paragraph numId/ilvl against bounded word/numbering.xml definitions.
implementation.supported: Bullets with level-based canonical glyphs; decimal, decimalZero, lower/upper alphabetic and lower/upper Roman numbering; levels 0–8; level starts and num-level startOverride; resolvable %1–%9 marker references.
implementation.failureVisibility: Missing definitions, unsupported formats and unresolved references emit a DOCX list unresolved marker while retaining the original item text.
implementation.bounds: 8 MiB numbering XML through the existing bounded reader; DTD/ENTITY rejected; up to 4096 unique stored abstract definitions and 4096 unique number instances; levels 0–8; existing text limit and interruption handling retained.
limitations: Only explicit paragraph numPr is resolved; numbering inherited only through paragraph styles is not resolved.
Picture bullets, style-linked numbering and unsupported numFmt values are not reproduced; unsupported explicit definitions remain visible as unresolved markers.
Bullet symbols use deterministic textual glyphs by nesting level and do not reproduce source-font visual symbols.

red.observedFailure: The test showed five plain item strings without any list marker; the bullet-preservation assertion failed.

intermediateGreen.note: Passed before startOverride assertions were added; superseded by greenFinal.

sourceTask.classification: Preparatory parser behavior only. M02-01 and the remaining M02-03 definition of done are open.

auxiliaryProbe.detail: A wrapper --version probe omitted GRADLE_USER_HOME and --offline, attempted to download Gradle and received Connection refused. It ran no task and is not build/test evidence. A corrected wrapper version probe then succeeded with /workspace/.gradle and --offline; both test invocations used the existing cache offline.
